name: Hyrcanian Forests
description: A band of ancient broadleaf forest runs along the southern Caspian Sea, across northern Iran and into Azerbaijan. It is a living remnant of woodland that once blanketed much of the northern temperate zone 25 to 50 million years ago. Some trees are 300 to 500 years old, and the forest shelters leopards, wolves and brown bears among more than 3,200 plant species.
